description: This file defines the syntax highlighting mode for Rust programming language for the CodeMirror editor. It specifies regex patterns for syntax elements like strings, numbers, keywords, comments, and defines how to parse and categorize Rust code in the editor.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a new simple mode for syntax highlighting in CodeMirror, here used to define Rust syntax.

methods.name: CodeMirror.defineMIME
methods.description: Associates MIME types with the defined syntax mode, enabling automatic detection and syntax highlighting.
